scope: Proposition 14.8 (Different-colour conflicts) of the manuscript “A counterexample to the Colin de Verdière chromatic conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-the-Colin-de-Verdiere-chromatic-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 97677c7a183884f0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 107-108. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let the early constant ηcol > 0 satisfy ηcol < 1 4 c∗, c∗ := δ2 ∗ 64 , where δ∗ is the retained-mass margin in (10.9). This choice depends on the original endpoint bound M and the early geometric constants, and precedes the selector and channel dimensions. For every fixed finite palette and all sufficiently large n, a unit law with both endpoint marginals bounded by Mπ, pair law after forgetting colour bounded by 23000gN π2, and each colour of mass at most ηcol satisfies Pr{A and B have four cross holes and different colours} ≥ 2−100gN , 107 where A, B are independent draws from that law. In particular, Theorem 5.4(i) holds.
